mobbin:3c069b65-da04-47ec-a852-5165ac635.summary: The user picks Voice note, records with a live transcript layer and large Stop control, pauses through Saving, then reviews Transcript and Summary tabs before the note appears on Home.
steps: Home with recent Untitled voice note card
Record: empty My notes and Stop at 00:00:00
Record: live transcript layer and Stop at 00:00:30
Paused: Saving voice note message and Summary spinner
Paused My notes: iPhone Microphone and Resume
Transcript tab: text block and scrubber 00:00
Summary tab: bulleted AI summary and Resume
Home: voice note card with transcript preview
steal: Large white Stop and Resume on the floating bar (screens 3 to 5) give a big-target record control for one-hand use.
A live transcript layer while still on My notes (screen 4) confirms capture without leaving the note.
My notes, Transcript and Summary tabs (screens 5 to 9) separate freeform notes from speech-to-text (STT) and a skim summary.
An iPhone Microphone source label (screens 5 to 8) names the audio input clearly.
avoid: There is no on-device versus cloud transcription indicator and no per-line timestamps on Transcript (screens 6 to 7), only scrubber time. That is weak for GDPR-sensitive or moment-linked faculty notes.
mobbin:3c069b65-da04-47ec-a852-5165ac635.fit: Mobile and iPad app: mobile wins for dictating a note at the bedside of a live session. Extends baseline voice notes, but Essentials needs on-device STT labeling and timestamp anchors Otter-style. Fabric does not show those.

mobbin:c10feffc-9e32-4467-914a-72668daa0.summary: From a paused video the user opens draw tools, marks a person with a freehand circle, saves the drawing, then sees it as a timestamped Drawing entry in Comments.
steps: Video player: pencil, comment, hide, settings
Draw mode: tool rail plus Cancel or Save drawing
Markup: blue circle on subject and Save drawing
Saved: drawing on frame, avatar on scrubber, Comments 1
Comments: Drawing · 00:00:00 badge and Timestamp on compose
steal: Cancel versus Save drawing on the frame (screens 2 to 4) lets you discard without leaving the player.
A hide-annotations eye switch beside the pencil (screens 1 and 5) toggles clean playback versus markup view.
A Drawing · 00:00:00 type-and-time badge in the comment list (screen 6) makes annotation kind visible at a glance.
A timestamp label on the compose field (screen 6) keeps the next text reply anchored to the same moment.
avoid: Vertical tool rail icons stay relatively small on the frame (screens 2 to 4). That is risky for gloved faculty; enlarge primary pen and save.
mobbin:c10feffc-9e32-4467-914a-72668daa0.fit: Mobile and iPad app: mobile is strong for private frame markup during debrief walk-around. Extends baseline debrief annotations. Keep big-screen control on web or SRV; phone or tablet for personal draws.

mobbin:65f315e4-072d-473a-8c75-05053aba2.summary: In a note with two unchecked items the user taps the second checkbox and it becomes a filled check with strikethrough text before Save.
steps: Note: two unchecked checklist rows and Save
Note: second item checked with strikethrough and Save
steal: Checked status uses a filled box plus strikethrough text (screen 2), so completion is clear at a glance.
avoid: Standard small checkbox hit targets (screens 1 to 2) fail gloved or one-hand live-event checklist use.
mobbin:65f315e4-072d-473a-8c75-05053aba2.fit: Mobile and iPad app: this does not beat desktop for live sim rubrics. It is a weak counter to baseline checklist. Keep large switches, partial credit and auto-timestamp elsewhere.
